mathematicalAssessment.servingLaw: For rows 2..511, start from own full-vocabulary BF16 H0; use shared input-defined trees to select two slot-specific FP32 local constants; each ordered addition is Python binary64 -> FP32 RNE -> BF16 RNE. Rows 0..1 copy the fixed contextual prefix cofactor. No original learned affine/gated map is evaluated by serving.
mathematicalAssessment.capacity: Two slots, depth<=4 and <=16 leaves/atoms per slot, local width2560, minimum8 fitting rows. Slot0 is position-only; content slot1 is fitted to native H1 minus the actually rounded slot0 output. The matched-capacity control shares slot0 and uses a position-only second tree.
mathematicalAssessment.features: Owned complete token/mask/position packet; causal active count; count/first/last literal registers for <=64 sorted discovery IDs; 16 fixed current lexical coordinates and active-prefix means. No future-token, prompt-ID/hash, full-history lookup, native contextual state or projection feature. Unknown IDs retain their full H0 and generic features.
mathematicalAssessment.fitting: Four discovery histories equally weighted, active/padding balanced on rows2..511. Fixed finite threshold enumeration; stable ordering and first exact tie. Nonpositive split gain ends this declared algorithm, not evidence collection.
mathematicalAssessment.feedback: One offline half-strength slot1 alternative with unchanged predicates. Equal history/stratum/port weighted error/reference-energy ratio of actual C(Hhat)-C(H0) against C(Hnative)-C(H0); tie/undefined retains initial. Both alternatives and control remain evidence, selected program restored byte-exactly. This tests amplitude correction, not improved routing.
mathematicalAssessment.consumer: Original layer1 input RMS normalization and Q/K/V projections, B1×512×2560, Qwidth4096, K/Vwidth1024. Bound BF16 parameters, epsilon and historical numerical profile. No attention, Q/K head normalization/RoPE, MLP, next full block, denoiser, VAE or image.
mathematicalAssessment.split: Discovery A/B/00/10; reused public transfer01/11 released only after final own predictions seal. Seventh novel raw prompt has execution/ownership evidence only, not a native accuracy target.
mathematicalAssessment.interpretation: This is an approximate, offline-learned non-neural local writer program. It is not an exact symbolic derivation of the encoder or a complete arbitrary-prompt image generator.
